Module com.codependentvariables.aiandme
Package com.codependentvariables.aiandme.model

Class QuizTemplate

java.lang.Object
com.codependentvariables.aiandme.model.QuizTemplate
public class QuizTemplate extends Object
Represents a quiz or puzzle template. Stores quiz information, category details, and all associated questions.
